detailed_descriptions.en: "Hariti" is a realistic first-person psychological horror game. You will take on the role of a mother searching for her missing daughter, exploring a perilous and mysterious hospital in a spine-chilling, thrilling journey. Where is your daughter? What terrifying stories are hidden behind the walls of this horror hospital? ... Take up the appropriate "weapon" and uncover the secrets behind the story. [Dynamic Image Display] Distinctive Horror Experience: A unique blend of cultural dread and psychological tension. Exquisite Chinese Horror Scenes: Immerse yourself in hauntingly authentic settings. Terrifying Monster Design: Encounter grotesque creatures born from ancient folklore. Convoluted Plot Development: Unravel a mystery where nothing is as it seems.
